title: Powers
summary: Choose a power set around the role you want to play.

sections.title: How powers work
items: Choose your power set during character creation. Active powers unlock as you level; all active powers in your set are available at level 30.
Every power set supports the Damage role. Each also has a support role: Tank, Controller, or Healer.

sections.title: Tank power sets
items: Fire, Ice, Earth, Rage, and Atomic support tanking. Tanks attract enemy attention and absorb attacks to protect the group.

sections.title: Controller power sets
items: Gadgets, Mental, Light, Quantum, and Munitions support controlling. Controllers supply group power and incapacitate enemies.

sections.title: Healer power sets
items: Sorcery, Nature, Electricity, Celestial, and Water support healing. Healers restore the health of their teammates.

sections.title: Starting choices
items: Fire, Gadgets, Ice, Mental, Nature, and Sorcery are the classic character-creation power sets. Check current in-game access before purchasing additional powers.

title: Investigations
summary: Follow the green markers to complete investigation sets.

sections.title: Recognizing investigations
items: Investigation tokens use a green exclamation mark. They are a different collectible type from Collections and Player Briefings.

sections.title: Completion rewards
items: Completing an investigation awards an armor piece or accessory. Use the specific investigation guide to identify its reward and individual node locations.

sections.title: Where to begin
items: The source organizes investigations into Gotham, Metropolis, and Global groups. Start with the linked Viva la Lucha Libre guide for Cape Carmine node locations; the remaining individual investigation guides still await review.

title: Collections
summary: Find collection sets by neighborhood and reward.

Gotham University: Gotham University; reward listed as Breastplate of the Believer.

Centennial: Centennial Park; reward listed as Clockwork Diver's Helmet.

sections.title: Location precision
items: These are source-reported collection areas, not exact spawn coordinates. Individual map guides still need review.

title: Grab and Smash
summary: Retrieve five pieces of information inside the Cape Carmine Lighthouse duo.

sections.title: Before entering
items: The source identifies Arcane Edict #020 as the hero unlock. Its villain edict number is unspecified.
Track the mission in your Journal before queuing for Cape Carmine Lighthouse through On Duty. The source warns that the walk-in version does not work.

sections.title: Terminal route
items: After the Venom Supplier Diego fight, go through the door and look to the left.
Look in the room where you fight Killer Croc or Huntress.
Check the lobby for the Killer Croc and Deathstroke, or Huntress and Nightwing, fight.
Check the western side of the corridor leading to Bane.
Find the final terminal in the corridor leading to the exit.

sections.title: Rewards
items: The source lists 1,162 cash and a Source Mark. These values have not been verified in the current game.

videoReview.note: Search returned a different mission with an incidental phrase match; no video qualified.

title: Cape Carmine Lighthouse
summary: Find the Gotham landmark, mission entrance, and duo setting.

sections.title: Which version are you entering?
items: The source describes a Gotham landmark, a level 9 mission instance, and a Tier 1 duo under this name. Check which version your objective requires.
The source lists level 30 access and two Source Marks for the duo. These requirements and rewards have not been checked in the current game.

sections.title: Inside the lighthouse
items: Bane and his Venom-powered gang occupy the lighthouse. Nightwing and Killer Croc pursue Bane and his Venom supply.
The encounter cast varies by faction and mode. The source identifies Deathstroke with the hero duo and Huntress with the villain duo.

sections.title: Related objectives
items: Grab and Smash requires the queued duo rather than the walk-in instance. Track that quest before entering.
The Viva la Lucha Libre investigation includes two parts inside the lighthouse. Use its individual landmark descriptions to locate those nodes.

title: Viva la Lucha Libre
summary: Locate six investigation parts around Cape Carmine and its instances.

sections.title: Route overview
items: This six-part investigation is spread across Cape Carmine in Gotham's East End, including the Distribution Center and Cape Carmine Lighthouse instances.
Several outdoor parts have alternate nodes. The location descriptions below preserve those alternatives rather than implying a single fixed spawn.

sections.title: Six investigation parts
items: Use the map references with the landmarks in this table. The source does not supply numeric coordinates for these nodes.

table.caption: Source-reported investigation locations
rows: Four possible nodes: sidewalks west of the western cargo ship or east of the eastern cargo ship at Gotham Docks.

Three possible nodes: northeast corner of the Old Soder Cola Plant block near the Distribution Center entrance; northwest corner of the block north of the plant; Stagg Stop gas station northeast of the plant.
Distribution Center: southern side room next to the room containing Venom Supplier Diego.
Sidewalk north of Cape Carmine Lighthouse, or stairs south of the lighthouse.
Cape Carmine Lighthouse: middle of the room where Nightwing or Killer Croc fights Bane's Streetgang.
Cape Carmine Lighthouse: southeast corner of the Bane fight room.

sections.title: Completion reward
items: The source lists Gangster's Jacket, using the Classic Biker style, as the completion reward.
Heroes receive completion mail from Harvey Bullock; villains receive it from the Penguin. Read the message at a mail terminal.

title: Out in the Streets
summary: Disrupt Bane's Venom shipments at the Cape Carmine docks.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Travel to Cape Carmine in Gotham. Defeat 15 Bane thugs protecting the Venom shipments.
Collect samples from 20 shipment crates, and stop 10 Strongmen carrying Venom crates before delivery.

sections.title: Finding the mission area
items: The investigation guide identifies the Gotham Docks at Cape Carmine as this mission's area. Its first investigation-part map shows the surrounding dock area, not every mission objective.

The same investigation guide places alternate first-part nodes on sidewalks west of the western cargo ship and east of the eastern cargo ship. These are investigation landmarks, not guaranteed quest target positions.

sections.title: Before moving on
items: Follow the tracked mission objectives for remaining crate and enemy targets. No exact target coordinates are supplied by the reviewed sources.
The linked hero playthrough explicitly names this quest; the next chapter covers House of Venom.

title: House of Venom
summary: Locate Bane's distribution hub and take down Venom Supplier Diego.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Search for Bane's Venom Distribution Hub, interrogate his Street Soldiers, and confiscate Venom from his Razors.
Take down Venom Supplier Diego and arrest him. The mission source identifies him as the boss.

sections.title: Finding the hub
items: The mission article identifies the hub as the Distribution Center. The associated investigation guide places its entrance near the northeast corner of the Old Soder Cola Plant block in Cape Carmine.

An investigation node is also located in the southern side room next to Diego's room. The linked investigation maps provide entrance-area and interior context, not a marked route through every quest objective.

sections.title: Opposition and allies
items: The source lists Bane's minions, Muscle, Strongman, Razor, and Venom-affected dogs among the opponents.
The allies list distinguishes Nightwing for heroes and Killer Croc for villains. The linked video is a Batman-mentor hero playthrough.

title: Feats
summary: Earn feat points, gain skill points, and understand optional unlocks for alternate characters.

sections.title: Earning skill points
items: Feats reward completion of challenges across exploration, solo content, group instances, PvP, and other activities. Every 100 feat points grants one additional skill point, allowing progression beyond the points gained through leveling.

sections.title: Star ratings and points
items: Read the requirement of each feat before attempting it. Four-star feats are special rewards and do not necessarily demand more effort than three-star challenges.

sections.title: Unlocking feats on another character
items: Replay badges can grant eligible feats already earned by another character. This is optional: feats can still be earned by completing their normal requirements. Only feats shared by the characters are eligible, so movement-specific feats cannot be transferred to an incompatible movement type.

The source lists badge costs of 1, 3, 5, and 7 for feats worth 10, 25, 50, and 100 points respectively. Check the in-game unlock confirmation before spending badges. Some event-progression feats can instead be obtained on other characters by reclaiming their associated rewards.

sections.title: Finding your next goal
items: Use the feats menu to inspect requirements and progress. A yellow ribbon marks feats that also award a title. The menu was reorganized in Game Update 135; older screenshots and navigation instructions may differ from the current interface.

title: Equipment
summary: Understand weapons, costume pieces, and the other items your character carries.

sections.title: Choosing weapons
items: Your weapon type determines the attacks and combos available in combat. Weapon types offer different combinations of ranged and melee attacks. Characters can develop more than one weapon type; choose based on the attacks you want to use and your combat role.

sections.title: Costume equipment
items: Costume pieces contribute character statistics. Role and character-level requirements can restrict which pieces you can equip. Compare usable equipment separately from its visual style when choosing upgrades.

sections.title: Other item types
items: Inventory items serve several purposes beyond equipped armor and weapons. Trinkets and consumables can assist in combat, collection items contribute to sets, and base items provide decoration. Currency and crafting materials have separate progression uses.

sections.title: Weapon types
items: The source lists Bow, Brawling, Dual Pistols, Dual Wield, Hand Blaster, Martial Arts, One-Handed, Rifle, Shield, Staff, and Two-Handed. For cross-weapon combos, see the Weapon Mastery guide. Check current in-game access requirements for restricted weapon types.

title: Weapon Mastery
summary: Unlock stronger weapon combos and chain attacks into another weapon type.

sections.title: Unlocking mastery
items: Weapon Mastery becomes available after spending the required stat points in a weapon tree. Unlocking mastery for your equipped weapon increases damage from its weapon combos. Check the tree in game for the exact point requirements.

sections.title: Multiple Mastery
items: Cross-weapon combos require the corresponding mastery unlocks in the other weapon trees. You do not need to own a secondary weapon item to perform its unlocked mastery combo. Unlocking the combo also adds an appearance option in the Style UI.

sections.title: Combo reference
items: Each row lists the secondary weapon trees and the four combo sequences recorded by the source. The first two sequences are labeled melee and the last two ranged in that reference. These are source-listed sequences, not independently tested damage rankings.

sections.title: Practice and appearance
items: The source notes that mastery combos can be performed without hitting an enemy or sparring target. Secondary and tertiary weapon appearances can be selected in the style menu, including a default energy-construct appearance using the primary character color.
